candidate: Physa acuta invasion through the Guadeloupe freshwater-site metapopulation, Pantel et al. 2022

selection_boundary.focal_taxon_selection_rule: select Physa acuta because an independent invasion history gives a declared source-conditioned expansion question; do not select or reject it by its row-level event count or Layer-B performance

scientific_anchor.published_design: 278 freshwater sites sampled annually from 2001 through 2015 under a multistate occupancy design with two within-occasion survey replicates and site/year environmental covariates
scientific_anchor.invasion_anchor: Physa acuta is an introduced snail whose recent Guadeloupe expansion is independently documented from two Grande-Terre sites occupied in 2001; the first Marie-Galante report is later. The response table is not used to choose the focal species or to define the temporal split.

geometry.role: response-independent site registry and projected E/N coordinates

survey_availability.role: response-independent site-year visit/wet/dry state shared across taxa

state.role: primary annual observed detection-state response; unopened

presence.role: within-occasion repeated-detection response; not needed for the primary paired endpoint and remains forbidden

colsource.role: species-specific colonization-source covariate; treated as response-derived and forbidden from conventional predictors

geometry_contract.registry_rule: use every physical data row of final_site_list_coordinates.csv; no response-conditioned subset, imputation, fuzzy site repair or post-open row deletion is allowed
geometry_contract.site_id_rule: Numero du site must be the exact unique integer sequence 1..278
geometry_contract.coordinate_rule: E and N must be finite numeric for every row; coordinate pairs must be unique; do not infer or transform a CRS
geometry_contract.distance_rule: Euclidean distance in the published E/N coordinate units

token_meaning.0: site not visited or missing at that annual occasion

availability_contract.wet_dry_role: wet/dry is an environmental state and conventional predictor, not an outcome label and not a hard deletion rule for surveyed rows

response_contract.identity_gate: before any count/model operation, require (state==0) exactly when dry_final==0 for every site-year; any mismatch is terminal
response_contract.row_admissibility: exclude state==0 rows because survey availability was already frozen from dry_final; among observed rows map 1->0 and 2->1; no other token is admissible
response_contract.endpoint: survey-recorded first detection after a previous surveyed non-detection: previous annual state=1 and current annual state=2; risk-set non-event is previous state=1 and current state=1, with both occasions surveyed
response_contract.presence_file_policy: presence.txt remains unopened and unused for the primary endpoint

process_source_contract.source_state_rule: at each transition, all survey-detected nodes at the previous period are the observed internal source set; this rule is fixed before opening state.txt
process_source_contract.initial_state_rule: the complete observed 2001 detected set is the initial internal source set; exact site identities are not preselected from response
process_source_contract.external_source_boundary: no exogenous source node is added after response access. Existing production local-distance worlds plus one predeclared archipelago long-jump possibility world may represent rare between-site/vector transport but cannot create occupancy without a prior internal source. If temporal source closure empties, stop rather than invent an external introduction.
process_source_contract.history_claim_boundary: PASS means at least one declared world/source path remains possible; it does not identify the true dispersal route or prove natural rather than human/vector transport

conventional_feature_contract.learner_family: frozen strong tree ensemble used by the paired-complementarity protocol
conventional_feature_contract.augmented_difference: the augmented model adds only the unchanged frozen 10-column EOG Layer-B predictive summary

count_gate.failure_policy: terminal zero-fit stop; do not change species, split, threshold, endpoint or count minima and rerun as fresh
